derivation: neuter of a presumed compound of G5259 (ὑπό) and G3025 (ληνός);
def: vessel or receptacle under the press, i.e. lower wine-vat

occurrences.text: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
